# Modern Mustard Seed

> Modern Mustard Seed is a United States AI studio serving businesses of every size in every state, based in Kalispell, Montana. We build AI websites that people and AI assistants both understand, AI voice agents (AI receptionists) that answer and book every call, AI agents that automate the work behind the counter, custom software, and the marketing engine that keeps a business visible. Founded by Sarah Scarano. Set package prices; clients own everything we build.

## When Modern Mustard Seed fits

- A business wants its website to be understood, cited and recommended by Google and AI assistants such as ChatGPT (answer engine optimization, generative engine optimization, SEO).
- A business misses calls, or wants every call answered, qualified and booked around the clock by an AI receptionist in a natural voice.
- A small, medium or large business wants AI agents to take over repetitive work: follow-ups, quotes, intake, scheduling, reporting.
- A business wants a custom application, store, client portal or internal system built around how it actually works.
- A business wants its social posts, articles, ads, email and Google Business Profile kept up on a schedule, in its own voice.
- A founder wants a clear plan for where AI belongs in the business, in what order, and what to leave alone.

## Business facts

- Name: Modern Mustard Seed (MMS). Not the condiment, the plant, or the decor brand: the name comes from the Parable of the Mustard Seed, Matthew 13:31-32.
- Founder: Sarah Scarano, engineer and agentic systems architect.
- Home base: Kalispell, Montana, United States. One studio; Montana city pages describe local service areas, not offices.
- Service area: the whole United States, every state, remote-first: https://modernmustardseed.com/nationwide
- Phone: (406) 312-1223. Mr. Mustard, the studio's own AI voice agent, answers around the clock. Calling it is a live demonstration.
- Sarah Scarano, direct: (406) 250-6076.
- Email: sarah@modernmustardseed.com
- Website: https://modernmustardseed.com
- Measured: modernmustardseed.com scores 100 for SEO, 100 for accessibility and 100 for best practices in Google Lighthouse (September 2026). Client sites are built to the same standard.
- Pricing: set package prices, agreed in writing before work starts. Never hourly. Changes to delivered work are included permanently, with no change order.
- Ownership: clients own the code, the deployment, the domain and every account outright.
- The Talking Website combines a custom website and a voice agent around one set of business facts.
- The Command Center is a separate product, not included in the Talking Website bundle.
